To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the spatial and temporal changes of epigenetic marks in male germ cells of Hyacinthus orientails are related to the biological fate of the cells and the acquired functions.

the spatial distribution of epigenetic marks in mature cellular pollen grains is different for each type of nucleus and that these differences persist during in vitro pollen germination and pollen tube growth.
the epigenetic state and chromatin organization of the generative cell, vegetative cell and sperm cells are different in the mature pollen grain and that the epigenome is modified in the pollen tube.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the epigenetic mechanisms that control the male gametophytic cell differentiation and the development of pollen tubes.

the mechanisms of epigenetic control in the male gametophytic development of H. orientalis, which may be important for the regulation of male gamete development, fertilization and early plant embryo formation.
the epigenetic mechanisms of gene regulation during hyacinth male germ unit development.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the epigenetic modifications are important for the regulation of gene expression during male gametogenesis in Hyacinthus orienta...

the epigenetic status and the chromatin organization of all the analysed nuclei of the hyacinth male germline is not uniform, but rather is cell-specific, with a unique spatial and temporal localization of chromatin-modifying enzymes.
the epigenetic status in the male gametophytic cells is not uniform and the epigenetic state in the mature pollen grains and in the in vitro growing tubes is not the same.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the epigenetic status and the chromatin organization of the male germ unit nuclei are important in regulating the expression of the genes involved in pollen germination and tube growth.
in the male germinal cells of Hyacinthus orientails, epigenetic modifications are associated with the regulation of the nuclear activity and the acquisition of the male germ cell fates.

the epigenetic status in the male germ units of the mature pollen grains and in vitro growing pollen tube of hyacinth is different from that in other plant species and may be a unique feature of this species.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the epigenetic status in male gametophytes is not only important during the early stages of gametogenesis but is also crucial for the later stages of male gametophytic development.
the epigenetic status in H. orientalis male germ unit is not the result of a random process but is a consequence of the precise regulation of gene expression in the male germ cells.
epigenetic marks are not only present in mature pollen grains but are also involved in the regulation of gene expression in pollen tubes.
